lines.speaker: board
lines.text: SUPPLIES: walk up to a stand and press E to take one. It is lent to you and goes back when you leave the training grounds.

lines.speaker: board
lines.text: Press TAB to pick a potion and Q to use it. The healing, shield, speed and strength potions help you for a while.

lines.speaker: board
lines.text: Freeze Bombs and Burn Vials hit every enemy on screen. Try them on the test dummies at the bottom of this room. A Magnet Potion pulls nearby loot to you.
